items: Keep your edited notebook: predictions, tested scale/group functions, output metric, AWQ/GPTQ/NF4 explanations and plot readings.
Save topic03-layer-decision.json with the payload hash, candidate list, 4.30-bit uniform budget, calibration choice and unchanged held-out result.
Include the separate 100/99/99.5 clipping investigation and same-W/X uniform group64 versus block64 NF4 comparison. Distinguish their metadata costs; do not claim equal storage or GPU execution.
Save topic03-weights-full.png, topic03-weights-center.png, topic03-nf4-blocks.png and topic03-output-scatter.png. Keep matched bins, all-weight denominators, tail disclosures and labelled scopes.
Save topic03-preflight.json: application context, minimum correct out of twelve, maximum invalid count, rationale and CPU answers, frozen BEFORE GPU execution.

Keep the original evidence/<your attempt>/result.json: model/runtime/device identity, five trials per length and format, twelve natural answers per format, separate allocated/reserved memory and cleanup.
Save topic03-screening.json, topic03-timing.png and both topic03-confusion-*.png plots. Preserve individual mismatches and profiles in notebook/JSON; this small screen is not production approval.
Write topic03-decision.md using the short memo template: prediction, bounded decision, limitation and next experiment. Full tables and method answers remain attachments, not repeated in the memo.

Download and open every deliverable before disconnecting Colab. Preserve failed attempts separately as partial. Missing GPU execution is not run, never replaced by teacher results. Submit privately; do not export credentials or model caches.
